an3.34:1.3: lobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya doso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya moho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya
an3.34:2.1: yaṃ bhikkhave lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ yatthassa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati
an3.34:2.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye
an3.34:3.1: yaṃ bhikkhave dosapakataṃ kammaṃ dosajaṃ dosanidānaṃ dosasamudayaṃ yatthassa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati
an3.34:3.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye
an3.34:4.1: yaṃ bhikkhave mohapakataṃ kammaṃ mohajaṃ mohanidānaṃ mohasamudayaṃ yatthassa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati
an3.34:4.2: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye
an3.34:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave bījāni akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni sukhette suparikammakatāya bhūmiyā nikkhittāni
an3.34:5.3: evassu tāni bhikkhave bījāni vuḍḍhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyyuṃ
an3.34:5.4: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṃ lobhapakataṃ kammaṃ lobhajaṃ lobhanidānaṃ lobhasamudayaṃ yatthassa attabhāvo nibbattati tattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati
an3.34:5.5: yattha taṃ kammaṃ vipaccati tattha tassa kammassa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti diṭṭheva dhamme upapajje vā apare vā pariyāye
an3.34:6.4: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāya.
an3.34:7.3: alobho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya adoso nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya amoho nidānaṃ kammānaṃ samudayāya
an3.34:8.1: yaṃ bhikkhave alobhapakataṃ kammaṃ alobhajaṃ alobhanidānaṃ alobhasamudayaṃ lobhe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃanuppādadhammaṃ
an3.34:9.1: yaṃ bhikkhave adosapakataṃ kammaṃ adosajaṃ adosanidānaṃ adosasamudayaṃ dose vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃanuppādadhammaṃ
an3.34:10.1: yaṃ bhikkhave amohapakataṃ kammaṃ amohajaṃ amohanidānaṃ amohasamudayaṃ mohe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃanuppādadhammaṃ
an3.34:11.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave bījāni akhaṇḍāni apūtīni avātātapahatāni sāradāni sukhasayitāni
an3.34:11.4: masiṃ katvā mahāvāte vā ophuneyya nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya
an3.34:11.5: evassu tāni bhikkhave bījāni ucchinnamūlāni tālāvatthukatāni anabhāvaṃ katāni āyatiṃanuppādadhammāni
an3.34:11.6: evameva kho bhikkhave yaṃ alobhapakataṃ kammaṃ alobhajaṃ alobhanidānaṃ alobhasamudayaṃ lobhe vigate evaṃ taṃ kammaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃ kataṃ āyatiṃanuppādadhammaṃ
an3.34:12.4: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi nidānāni kammānaṃ samudayāyāti.
